name: Spartoi
body:
It is said that the first spartoi were born when a powerful human king sowed enchanted dragon teeth in the soil, and the magic within them caused humanoid beings to grow from earth rather than plants. It’s more likely that these fierce warriors are descendants of humans with the halfdragon template, with the draconic blood in their veins more diluted but still strongly flowing. This grants them great strength and courage in battle, a longer life compared to that of mere humans, and an almost supernatural beauty.

Standard Racial Traits
Type: Humanoid. (draconic, human)
Size: Medium
Speed: 30 ft.
Ability Score Modifiers: Standard +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom. Spartoi are hardy and difficult to kill, and their draconic heritage makes them fascinating, but they are also rash and headstrong by nature.
Languages: Standard Spartoi speak Common and Draconic. Spartoi with high Intelligence scores can choose from any of these additional languages: Dwarven, Elven, Gnomish, Goblin, Halfling, Orcish, Terran.
Defense Racial Traits
Draconic Resistance: Spartoi gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against sleep or paralysis effects.
Fearless: Spartoi gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.
Tireless: Spartoi halven the penalties for the fatigued (instead of the usual –2 penalty) and exhausted conditions. In addition, the rest time needed to recover from either condition is halved.
Magical Racial Traits
Draconic Sorcery: Spartoi bloodragers or sorcerers with the draconic bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all spells and class abilities. This trait does not give a spartos early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers that they could already use without this trait.
Offense Racial Traits
Weapon Familiarity x2: Spartoi are proficient with the shortspear, javelin, short sword and shields (except tower shields).
Senses Racial Traits
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet
Senses: Low-light vision
Draconic (Subtype)

Creatures with the draconic subtype are distant relatives of true dragons or can trace their ancestry to draconic magic, though they don’t have all the abilities of half-dragons.

A draconic race has the darkvision 60 feet, draconic resistance, and low-light vision racial traits.

Alternate Racial Traits
Breath Weapon: Choose one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Then pick either a 15-foot cone or a 20-foot line. Once per day, as a standard action, a spartos with this trait can make a supernatural breath weapon attack that deals 1d6 points of the damage type chosen in the area chosen. All creatures within the affected area must make a Reflex saving throw to avoid taking damage. The save DC against this breath weapon is 10 + 1/2 the user’s character level + the user’s Constitution modifier. Those who succeed at the save take no damage from the attack. This racial trait replaces draconic sorcery.
Draconic Affinity: Spartoi oracles with either the dragon mystery or a mystery related to their draconic ancestor’s element (Flame, Stone, Waves, or Wind) who have this trait treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all mystery spells and class abilities. Spartoi clerics and inquisitors with the Scalykind domain and the Dragon subdomain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This racial trait replaces draconic resistance and draconic sorcery.
Draconic Bite: A spartos with this racial trait possesses little sharp fangs, a reminder of her dragon ancestor, that grant her a bite attack dealing 1d3 damage. The bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the spartos is wielding manufactured weapons. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.
Draconic Blood: Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. A spartos with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take damage of this type (whether or not this damage overcomes his energy resistance, if any). Spartoi can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces draconic resistance and tireless.
Draconic Scales: A spartoi with this racial trait gains a +1 natural armor bonus to his Armor Class.
Dragon Tail: A spartos with this racial trait has a tail he can use to make attacks of opportunity with a reach of 5 feet. The tail is a natural attack that deals 1d8 points of damage plus the spartos’ Strength modifier. This racial trait replaces draconic resistance and tireless.
Energy Resistance: Pick acid, cold, electricity, or fire. A spartoi with this racial trait has resistance 5 to the corresponding energy type. This racial trait replaces draconic sorcery.
Vestigial Wings: A spartoi with this racial traits has wings that do not provide the lift required for actual flight, but do have enough power to aid flight attained by some other method, and grant a +4 racial bonus on Fly checks. This racial trait replaces tireless.
Calidonian Heritage

Short, fierce, and hairy, these spartoi are said to be descended from wild mythological boars.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence.
Alternate Racial Trait: Whenever a calidonian is reduced to half its hit points or fewer and has no conscious ally within 30 feet, it gains a +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and to Armor Class. This replaces darkvision 60 ft., draconic resistance, and draconic sorcery.
Type Calidonians have the calidonian subtype rather than the draconic subtype.
Lemnoi Heritage

These spartoi have more in common with hydras than dragons and share some of these monsters’ regenerative ability.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, -2 Dexterity.
Alternate Racial Trait: Lemnoi gain DR 2/fire. This replaces draconic resistance and draconic sorcery.
